issues.detail: The Greek 'ηνειχεσθε' (enichesthe) is in the middle voice/passive and carries the sense of 'enduring' or 'bearing' a burden, but the Vietnamese 'chịu đựng được thật tốt' (endured very well/well-tolerated) adds a positive evaluative quality ('thật tốt') that is not present in the Greek text. The Greek conveys the irony of the situation rather than a commendation of their endurance.
